ldapsearch -x -H ldap://dc01.lab.local -b "DC=lab,DC=local" "(objectClass=user)"
# extended LDIF
#
# LDAPv3
# base <DC=lab,DC=local> with scope subtree
# filter: (objectClass=user)
# requesting: ALL
#

# Administrator, Users, lab.local
dn: CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=lab,DC=local
objectClass: top
objectClass: person
objectClass: organizationalPerson
objectClass: user
cn: Administrator
sAMAccountName: Administrator
memberOf: CN=Domain Admins,CN=Users,DC=lab,DC=local

# jdoe, Users, lab.local
dn: CN=John Doe,OU=Engineering,DC=lab,DC=local
objectClass: user
cn: John Doe
sAMAccountName: jdoe

# results: 2
